resources.string: Twitch resume test
Enable Twitch resume test
Adds a manual test to the VoD player’s More menu. Automatic sync has separate account controls in Twitch sync.

Experimental account compatibility test.
Account ID: %1$s
VoD: %2$s

Reads preserve local progress. Sending requires confirmation and changes this VoD’s resume position on Twitch. Keep other Twitch players closed during the test.
Read Twitch position
Seek to the Twitch position
Read Continue Watching
Send current playback position…
Send and verify
Send %1$s for account %2$s, VoD %3$s?\n\nThis replaces the Twitch resume position, including when rewinding. Only this captured player position is sent. Local history is preserved.
Choose a test. No request has been sent.
Checking account and contacting Twitch…
Account verified. Twitch position: %1$s. Reading has not moved the player.
No saved position
Account verified. Continue Watching returned no entries.
Write accepted and read back at %1$s. Close this player, then check the official Twitch app to complete the test. This does not verify watch-streak credit.
Twitch accepted the write, but verification could not finish: %1$s. Read the position again before deciding to send another write.
Twitch accepted %1$s, but readback returned %2$s. Another player or Twitch processing may have changed it. Automatic sync is still off.
If a request reached Twitch before the failure, the position may have changed. Read it again before retrying. Nothing will retry automatically.
A signed-in account and GraphQL token/client ID are required. A Helix login alone is insufficient.
The token belongs to a different account. No further operation was sent.
The token’s client ID does not match the configured GraphQL client. Check the account settings.
The account, credentials or player session changed. Close and reopen this test.
Twitch rejected authentication or integrity, or the token expired. Refresh the app login before testing again.
Twitch no longer recognizes this captured operation. A current protocol capture is needed.
Twitch returned a GraphQL error. This operation has not been verified.
Twitch returned an unsuccessful HTTP response. No automatic retry will occur.
The request failed or timed out. No automatic retry will occur.
Twitch returned an unexpected response or identity. The result was not applied locally.
This VoD is unavailable for the position query.
Wait for the VoD to load and play before capturing its position.
